issues.root_cause: CLI `brahm integrity check` and `brahm reports generate` freshly scanned live disk files into a new `GenuineLayer` and compared the repository against itself, causing post-install tampering of genuine files to report 0 unexpected changes; reconnect also overwrote baseline hashes.
issues.impact: Integrity monitoring from the CLI failed to detect post-connect or post-install modification, deletion, or addition of repository source files.
issues.fix_applied: Persisted `BRAHM_BASELINE.json` inside `state_dir` during initial `RepositoryInputManager::connect_internal`, preserved `baseline_fingerprint` across idempotent re-connections, persisted `BRAHM_ARCHITECTURE.json`, `BRAHM_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json`, and `BRAHM_SYMBOL_INDEX.json`, and updated `handle_integrity_check` and `handle_reports_generate` in `src/main.rs` to load `BRAHM_BASELINE.json` via `load_stored_baseline`.

issues.root_cause: When `follow_symlinks = false`, symlink files still entered `inspect_file` and `fingerprint_files` (`File::open`), allowing symlinked targets outside the repository boundary to be opened or hashed; broken symlinks when `follow_symlinks = true` also risked scan failures.
issues.impact: Potential symlink boundary escape during inspection/hashing and noisy warnings on broken symlinks.
issues.fix_applied: Short-circuited symlinks cleanly in `Scanner::scan` when `follow_symlinks = false`, canonicalized and rejected broken or root-escaping symlinks when `follow_symlinks = true`, and skipped `FileType::Symlink` entries inside `fingerprint_files`.

issues.root_cause: CLI `protection install`, session lifecycle transitions (`deception stop`, `deception cleanup`), and agent sandbox inspection did not automatically record lifecycle events into `state_dir/brahm_monitoring.db`, and no `brahm agent run` CLI command existed to drive `LocalTestAgentAdapter` into persistent telemetry.
issues.impact: Automated telemetry correlation and SQLite audit history were incomplete unless custom Rust code manually invoked monitoring APIs.
issues.fix_applied: Updated `ProtectionInstaller::install` to activate the prepared inspection session and record `DecoyCreated`, `InspectionSessionStarted`, registered decoy refs, and session metadata in `brahm_monitoring.db`; added `record_session_lifecycle_if_db` for `Stop`/`Cleanup`; added `brahm agent run <session_id> --state-dir <dir> --paths ...` CLI command.

issues.root_cause: `brahm decoy` and `brahm deception` standalone commands default to `.brahm_decoys` / `.brahm_sessions`, whereas unified workflows under `brahm protection` / `brahm monitor` nest artifacts inside `--state-dir` (`.brahm_state/{decoys,sessions}`).
issues.impact: Chaining standalone `decoy`/`deception` subcommands with `monitor`/`protection` requires passing matching `--decoy-dir` / `--session-dir` / `--state-dir` arguments explicitly.
issues.fix_applied: Preserved backward-compatible CLI defaults to avoid breaking existing automation while documenting exact flag matching conventions across integrated workflows.
issues.verification_method: CLI argument compatibility tests in tests/stage04_deception.rs and tests/stage05_integration.rs

issues.subsystem: Stage 02 Code Intelligence (SQL Schemas & Express Routes)
issues.root_cause: `DataModelDetector` exited early on any `.sql` file matching `/db/` with a single `SqlMigration` model instead of parsing `CREATE TABLE` DDL definitions; `detect_js_routes` captured the first identifier argument in Express/Router calls, picking middleware names (e.g. `requireAuth`) instead of final route handlers.
issues.impact: Under-counted database tables in `db/schema.sql` files and misattributed route handler symbols in middleware-wrapped Express/TypeScript APIs.
issues.fix_applied: Updated `DataModelDetector::detect_from_text` to keep `/migration` as `SqlMigration` while parsing all `CREATE TABLE` definitions in non-migration SQL schemas as `SchemaDefinition`; updated `detect_js_routes` to extract the final named argument via `args.named_child(named_count - 1)`.

issues.root_cause: Local Axum monitoring server exposed health, repositories, events, sessions, decoys, integrity, and monitoring reports, but lacked endpoints for `/api/v1/architecture`, `/api/v1/deception`, `/api/v1/rating`, and `/api/v1/experiment`, and omitted localhost-restricted CORS headers for browser UI clients.
issues.impact: A local browser dashboard could not retrieve architecture, deception policy, rating, or scorecard payloads or pass browser CORS preflight checks.
issues.fix_applied: Added authenticated GET routes `/api/v1/architecture`, `/api/v1/deception`, `/api/v1/rating`, and `/api/v1/experiment` plus strict `localhost_cors_middleware` (`http://localhost[:port]` / `http://127.0.0.1[:port]` with numeric port validation, rejecting spoofed or external origins).

issues.root_cause: `DecoyRegistry::cleanup_owned_artifacts` deleted owned decoy files without pruning empty subdirectories created during decoy staging (`canary/`, `docs/`, `config/`, etc.).
issues.impact: Empty decoy subdirectories persisted on disk after non-dry-run decoy cleanup.
issues.fix_applied: Added bottom-up empty subdirectory pruning confined strictly inside `decoy_layer_root` during non-dry-run cleanup while keeping `decoy_layer_root` intact.

issues.root_cause: Root `README.md` needed full Stage 07 documentation, BRAHM branding badge, rating integration, and Coding Agent rules; the React + TypeScript monitoring dashboard (`dashboard/`) was not yet built.
issues.impact: Public presentation and visual telemetry inspection required Phase 9 and Phase 10 deliverables.
issues.verification_method: Vite TypeScript production build check and README audit in Phases 9-11

issues.root_cause: On Windows, `std::fs::canonicalize` produces extended-length UNC verbatim prefixes (`\\?\D:\...`) in absolute display paths.
issues.impact: Cosmetic display prefix in Windows absolute path logs; internal relative paths and POSIX normalization (`/` separators) remain unaffected.
issues.fix_applied: No functional mutation required; internal relative paths remain platform-normalized across reports and telemetry.
issues.verification_method: Verified deterministic relative path normalization across tests/milestone07_stage02_validation.rs
